⚡ WebSerial Direct Flasher

Install AuraClimate ESP32

Flash and install the full humidity, temperature, NTP time sync, and 24-hour daily logging firmware directly to your ESP32 in your browser. Zero drivers or command-line tools required.

1
Connect Hardware
Plug your ESP32 into this computer via USB cable. Connect your DHT11 data pin to GPIO 22.
2
Click Install
Click the Install button below and choose your USB Serial port (CP210x / CH340) from the browser prompt.
3
Wi-Fi & Dashboard
Once flashed (takes ~30s), connect to the ESP32 to view real-time climate gauges, charts, and CSV logs.

Browser One-Click Installer

Uses the standard WebSerial browser API (Chrome, Edge, Opera, Brave). Works on Windows, Mac, Linux, and Chromebooks.

⚠️ WebSerial is not supported in this browser. Please open this page in Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, or Brave. ⚠️ HTTPS is required for WebSerial. Host this page on GitHub Pages, Netlify, or Vercel.

📋 Hardware & Pinout Specifications
• Microcontroller: ESP32 Dev Module (240MHz, 4MB Flash)
• Sensor: DHT11 Relative Humidity & Ambient Temperature
• Data Line: GPIO 22 (Pin D22)
• Activity Indicator: GPIO 2 (Built-in Blue LED)
• Web Server: Built-in asynchronous HTTP server (Port 80)
• Time Server: UDP NTP (pool.ntp.org)
• CSV Telemetry: /api/history.csv (24h Circular Ring)
• Default Wi-Fi: Tech Vue / maxmus8085
